spots.name: Artistic Images
spots.blurb: You've reached Artistic Images, a mural. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.

spots.name: Scottsboro Boys Mural
spots.blurb: You've reached Scottsboro Boys Mural, a mural by Don Howard. The nine Scottsboro Boys being arrested after being taken from a train. At right, people march 'towards the future.' Above: Judge Horton, Sheriff Matt Wann, and attorney Leibowitz, who helped the Boys avoid death. At the top are all nine Scottsboro Boys.
